_comment: Act 1 enemy roster (issue #16). kinds: stats per enemy type, read by scripts/enemy_kinds.gd (hp, damage, speed, xp; the Nibbler's bite stays in scripts/enemy.gd; pack = how many spawn together (one fewer, sometimes); tip = one-line hint shown the first time one notices the party). rosters: spawn weights per province (the Act 1 areas); a mission can override with its own "enemies" dict; anything not listed uses default.

spitter.name: Spitter
spitter.tip: Spitter: it swells before it spits. Step aside, then close in.

moth.name: Letter-moth
moth.tip: Letter-moths: they flash red, then dive. Swing as they come in.

enforcer.name: Tithe Enforcer
enforcer.tip: Tithe Enforcer: his Ledger shield halves hits from the front. Hit him from behind, and leave the red ring.
